name: @mezentsev/mcp-web

tools.name: duckduckgo-search
tools.description: Search the web using DuckDuckGo and return results

tools.name: fetch-url
tools.description: Fetch the content of a URL and return it as text, with options to control extraction

excludeTags.description: Tags to exclude from extraction (default: script, style, etc.)

extractMainContent.description: Whether to attempt to extract main content (default: true)

includeImages.description: Whether to include image alt text (default: true)

includeLinks.description: Whether to include link text (default: true)

maxLength.description: Maximum length of content to return (default: 10000)

tools.name: url-metadata
tools.description: Extract metadata from a URL (title, description, etc.)

url.description: The URL to extract metadata from

tools.name: felo-search
tools.description: Search the web for up-to-date technical information like latest releases, security advisories, migration guides, benchmarks, and community insights

stream.description: Whether to stream the response (default: false)

tools.name: url-fetch
tools.description: Fetch web pages and convert them to markdown format

url.description: The URL to fetch and convert to markdown

serverInfo.name: DuckDuckGo, Google Search & Felo AI Search MCP
